item.title: Voxel Raytracer Devlog
item.description: Reproject spatial hash map indices 2026-09-01 Commit: c41b366 Splits the RTAO pass into two steps: Hash indices from the previous frame are reprojected to the current frame if the history and checksum is valid. The hash index is looked up otherwise. The current frame’s hash index is written to a texture. A fullscreen RTAO pass is done using the gbuffers and the hashmap index texture. A view of the index texture
